answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybils by making each agent lock a refundable deposit that is slashed on proven fraud, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand deposits instead of nothing. New identities start with velvet-soft trust: low limits that rise only through verified useful work, while a crystal-clear public ledger records every attestation and penalty. An atlas of endorsements shows who vouches for whom, and clusters of newcomers endorsing only each other are quarantined. Attackers must fund deposits and build real history per fake; honest agents pay once.
